info.description: Proves the Saga scenarios through the API Gateway. Run the folders in order on freshly created databases. [TODO-9.1]

item.name: Public watch list needs no token

exec: pm.test("every watch has categoryName", () => { pm.expect(list.length).to.be.at.least(8); list.forEach(w => pm.expect(w.categoryName).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty); });

item.name: Staff with forged role cannot delete

exec: pm.test("message", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Token is not a refresh token"));
pm.test("steps in exact order", () => pm.expect(actual).to.eql(["EXECUTE CREATE_WATCH SUCCESS", "EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS"]));

item.name: New watch is first in the list

exec: pm.test("first item is the new watch", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data[0].watchId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("newWatchId"))));
